以下Python 3代码执行完后，变量result是什么？用唯一键result输出其JSON等价值（Python布尔值按JSON布尔值表示）。
```python
def f(xs):
    stack = []
    out = [-1] * len(xs)
    for i, x in enumerate(xs):
        while stack and xs[stack[-1]] < x:
            j = stack.pop()
            out[j] = i - j
        stack.append(i)
    return out
result = [f(xs) for xs in [[5,3,3,6,2,7,7,1], [], [4,4,4], [1,3,2,5,4,6]]]
```
只输出一个合法JSON对象；不要Markdown围栏、解释或额外键。

tools.description: Execute bounded, self-contained Python mathematics and data transformations. No imports, files, network, process access or reflection. Assign the final JSON-compatible value to result. Supports assignments, if, for/while, comprehensions, functions/lambda, break/continue, arithmetic, lists/tuples/dicts/sets, slices and ordinary collection/string methods. Available functions: range,len,sum,min,max,abs,round,int,float,str,bool,list,tuple,dict,set, sorted,reversed,enumerate,zip,all,any,map,filter,print,ord,chr,comb,factorial,gcd,lcm,isqrt,pow, product,permutations,combinations,Fraction,Decimal,numerator,denominator,quantize_half_even. numerator/denominator extract exact Fraction parts. quantize_half_even(x,places=2) uses exact Decimal rounding. product accepts repeat; sorted accepts key and reverse. Execution is bounded to 20 seconds, 20 million interpreter steps, 100000 values per materialized collection, 1500000 total allocation units and 4096-bit integers. Prefer efficient algorithms; range can represent up to 1000000 iterations. The result and errors are computation outputs, not grading feedback.
